announcements.text: Raytheon, Tucson, Arizona, is being awarded a noncompetitive, multi-year undefinitized contract action on a new contract (HQ0851-27-C-E001). The base value of this contract is $4,432,040,944 with a total value, including options, of $6,342,404,516. Under this contract, the contractor will manufacture and assemble Standard Missile-3 Block IB All-Up-Rounds for the government. The work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona; and Huntsville, Alabama, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 31, 2034. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $454,215,132 are being obligated on this award. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 7, 2026).

announcements.text: Ernst & Young LLP, New York, New York, is being awarded a labor-hour contract with a maximum value of $455,430,043. This contract is for financial statement audit services for the Department of War Office of Inspector General, Audits of the Navy General Fund, the Marine Corps General Fund, and Department of Navy Working Capital Fund fiscal 2027-2031. Work will be performed in Tysons, Virginia, and other locations within and outside of the continental U.S., with an expected completion date of Dec. 31, 2031. The contract includes a one-year base period and four, individual one-year option periods. This contract is the result of a competitive acquisition for which the government received one quote. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $96,527,833 will be obligated, when available, prior to the start of performance. The Defense Finance and Accounting Service, Contract Services Directorate, Columbus, Ohio, is the contracting activity (HQ042327FE001).

announcements.text: Ernst & Young LLP, New York, New York, is being awarded a labor-hour contract with a maximum value of $413,954,469 for audit services of the Department of the Air Force general fund and working capital fund financial statements. Work will be performed in McLean, Virginia, with an expected completion date of Dec. 31, 2027. This contract is the result of a competitive acquisition for which one quote was received. announcements.text: Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA), Alexandria, Virginia, has been awarded a $51,699,826, cost-plus-fixed-fee task order for operational and support services. This task order will specifically support technical, programmatic, financial, and administrative management of new and ongoing technology programs. The location of performance is Arlington, Virginia. The work is expected to be completed by October 2027. This award is the result of a competitive acquisition, and two offers were received. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,066,115 are being obligated at the time of award. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (HR001127FE003).

announcements.text: Accenture Federal Services, LLC, Arlington, Virginia is awarded a $10,994,689 option modification (P00018) to previously awarded firm-fixed-price contract (HT003824C0004) for a total cumulative value of $45,975,743. Modification is a six-month option period in support of the Program Acquisition Executive – Medical Digital Solutions, Joint Operation Medicine Information Systems Program Management Office CustomerX Pod 2 initiative providing user adoption, training and exercise, and release and deployment support. This six-month option period begins Oct. 8, 2026, and concludes on April 7, 2027. Work location is within the contiguous United States, which could include Fort Campbell, Kentucky; the USS Kearsarge, Norfolk, Virginia; Fort Hood, Texas; Fort McCoy, Wisconsin; San Antonio, Texas; TravisAir Force Base, Dallas, Texas; Camp Beauregard, Louisiana; Tampa, Florida; and others to be determined; and outside the contiguous United States, which could include Pacific Command, Japan, Germany, Hawaii, South Korea, Bulgaria, Philippines, Poland, Kosovo, European Command, Italy, and others to be determined, or both. The option period is incrementally funded with the following: fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 procurement; and fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (when it becomes available). The Defense Health Agency, Defense Healthcare Management Systems Contracting Division, Rosslyn, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 28, 2026).

contracting_activity.name: The Defense Health Agency, Defense Healthcare Management Systems Contracting Division, Rosslyn, Virginia

extracted.description: Six-month option period for CustomerX Pod 2 initiative (user adoption, training and exercise, release and deployment support) under Medical Digital Solutions

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Tukwila, Washington, has been awarded a $10,889,535 fixed-price incentive (firm-target), firm-fixed-price modification (P00190) to a previously awarded contract (FA8625-16-C-65990) for VC-25B test maintenance. Work will be performed at San Antonio, Texas, and is expected to be completed prior to flight test. This modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $4,508,429,742 from $4,497,540,207. The modification is separate from the contract’s firm-fixed-price engineering and manufacturing development efforts. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $5,000,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.
